# Tova Translate

> Tova Translate is a free iOS camera-and-voice translation app for travellers across Asia, MENA and Europe. Point your camera at a sign, menu or contract and read it in English with per-character pronunciation — pinyin over Chinese, romaji over Japanese, Revised Romanization over Korean, Jyutping over Cantonese — across 118 languages. It works offline in China with no VPN. Free to download; Pro adds offline packs, Boardroom 3-way speech, document OCR and a medical/legal glossary.

## App
- [Tova Translate on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tova-translate/id6764455741): Download the free iOS app.

## Free browser tools
- [Pinyin converter](https://tovatranslate.app/tools/pinyin-converter/): Paste Chinese, get Hanyu Pinyin above each character. Handles polyphones at word level (银行 = yin hang, not yin xing) and works with simplified and traditional. Free, runs client-side.
- [Jyutping converter](https://tovatranslate.app/tools/jyutping-converter/): Paste Cantonese, get Jyutping with tone numbers above each character. Word-level readings (銀行 = ngan4 hong4) and colloquial Cantonese characters. Free, runs client-side.
- [Free tools hub](https://tovatranslate.app/tools/): Romanization tools built from the engine inside Tova Translate.

## Translation guides
- [Translation guides hub](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/): How to read menus, signs and characters with your phone.
- [Translate a Chinese menu](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/chinese-menu/): Scan a Chinese menu and read every dish in English with pinyin.
- [Translate Chinese signs](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/chinese-signs/): Read Chinese street and shop signs with pinyin.
- [Translate a Japanese menu with romaji](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/japanese-menu/): Read a Japanese menu with romaji above every kana and kanji.
- [Translate a Korean menu with romanization](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/korean-menu/): Read a Korean menu with Revised Romanization above the Hangul.
- [Translate Korean signs](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/korean-signs/): Read Korean signs and menus with romanization.
- [Cantonese translator with Jyutping](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/cantonese-jyutping/): Read Cantonese with Jyutping romanization.
- [Read Chinese characters with pronunciation](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/read-chinese-characters/): Get pinyin and meaning for any Chinese character.
- [Translator that works in China without a VPN](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/china-no-vpn/): Translate offline in China — no VPN needed.
- [Offline translator for travel in China](https://tovatranslate.app/translate/offline-translator-china/): On-device translation that works without a connection.
